Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School as Columbia Heights and incorrectly treated it as being on the Yellow line. The closest station is Shaw-Howard U on the Green/Yellow corridor north of L’Enfant. Counting from Shaw-Howard U to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport on the Yellow line yields 8 stations, not 9. This initial misidentification led to the incorrect final count, which the verifier then repeated.
